description: Structural families (spec 4.1): GE IR-prepared 3D T1 with reformats, Siemens MPRAGE with a split MPR, 2D spin-echo T1, 2D T1-FLAIR, 3D and 2D FLAIR (with overlapping slices), 2D T2. Rows and Columns are reduced to 28-48 while fields of view and slice spacing stay realistic, so coverage reaches 110 mm. Times are seconds after the session's earliest AcquisitionTime (reading RD-10). Volume keys in expected outcomes are series numbers; 'N:*' stands for all volumes of series N.

owner_decisions: 2026-11-24 (G1): accepted as written: no link state is expected for the mixed MPR; only its fate.
notes: The MPR series is mixed, so its record keeps no for_hash, TR or acq_rel_s. Whether the linking ladder then skips frame_of_reference, parameters and acquisition_time (and links at series_order) or uses the volumes' sidecar values is not settled by 5.6; no link state is expected here. Its fate (reformat, OTHER/T1) does not depend on it.
